runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Existing LIVE items are never removed merely because a discovery run does not rediscover them.
runSummary.note: Real 14.9.2026 12:10 sweep across 12 source families: Profesia, direct company careers/public ATS, LinkedIn public jobs indexing, Worki, Kariera/Zoznam, Brigada.sk, Pretlak, StartupJobs, WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and publicly indexed Facebook groups. IKEA Job ID 355434 is reconfirmed by the current IKEA Bratislava job list and Profesia mirror (posted 8.9.2026): full-time customer relations, partial home office, 1,260 EUR/month, no required experience, English only an advantage. Hemmersbach Job-Id 19971 is reconfirmed on canonical careers with active Apply now, Bratislava full-time, local/remote desktop support and 18 months IT experience or equivalent. Upwork returned several WooCommerce/e-commerce admin matches, but none passes economic/competition/language gates strongly enough to promote. StartupJobs Elasticr L2 remains outside the distance/remote certainty gate and is a stronger-skill role. Facebook produced 0 verified direct-post hits. No LIVE deletion was performed.

developmentChanges.title: Promotion write-size preflight
developmentChanges.reason: Before promoting into a large canonical feed, verify that the connector can round-trip the complete current file and preserve item count/hash. If full-content write safety cannot be proven, keep the candidate promotion-ready instead of risking feed corruption.

developmentChanges.title: Canonical list-membership auto-promotion queue
developmentChanges.reason: When a high-fit candidate is visible both on the employer's current vacancy list and on an active detail/apply surface for consecutive runs, move it to a prioritized promotion queue so strong roles do not remain outside LIVE unnecessarily.
